name: Commit
description: Behavioral commitment trust scoring for npm, PyPI, Cargo, and Go packages. Scores packages 0-100 on publisher depth, release consistency, download trend, and maintenance longevity — the credential-concentration signals npm audit and Dependabot miss. Catches the single-publisher pattern behind the axios (March 30 2026), LiteLLM (March 27 2026), and Miasma (June 2026) supply chain attacks.

authentication.note: Anonymous: 15 audits/day per IP (often CGN-shared). Free key (https://getcommit.dev/pricing) lifts to 200/day. Paid tiers: Developer $15/mo (1,000/day + batch), Pro $29/mo (10,000/mo), Enterprise $199/mo (unlimited).

skills.name: Audit Package Dependencies
skills.description: Score one or more packages on behavioral commitment signals. Returns score (0-100), risk flag (HEALTHY, WARN, HIGH, CRITICAL, COMPROMISED), publisher count, weekly downloads, package age, release trend, scoreBreakdown, and risk reasons. Supports up to 20 packages per call.

examples.output: Per-package score with risk flag + scoreBreakdown { longevity, momentum, releases, publishers, github, provenance }

examples.input: Score @anthropic-ai/sdk and its transitive npm dependencies up to depth 2
examples.output: Tree with CRITICAL/HIGH highlighted; @anthropic-ai/sdk scores healthy but 2 transitive deps are CRITICAL

skills.name: Audit GitHub Repository
skills.description: Fetch a GitHub repo's package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, or go.mod and score every dependency. Supports owner/repo slug or full GitHub URL.

examples.output: Full dependency scan with CRITICAL/HIGH/HEALTHY counts and per-package scores

skills.name: Audit Transitive Dependency Tree
skills.description: Walk a package's npm dependency tree to depth 1 or 2 (up to 20 nodes) and highlight CRITICAL paths. Direct deps may score HEALTHY while transitive deps carry the actual risk.

skills.name: Lookup Single Package Profile
skills.description: Detailed profile for one package: lookup_npm_package, lookup_pypi_package, lookup_cargo_crate, lookup_go_module. Returns maintainer list, release history, download trend, GitHub link, and current risk flag.

skills.name: Package Watchlist + Weekly Digest
skills.description: Watch up to 3 packages (free) or 25+ (paid) and receive a weekly email digest plus immediate alerts when score drops, a maintainer is added, or COMPROMISED flag fires. Auto-seeded from /audit scan results on signup.

examples.input: Watch axios, lodash, express; email me@company.com
examples.output: Watchlist created, weekly digest scheduled, immediate alert wired for COMPROMISED events

skills.name: Lookup Norwegian Business Registry
skills.description: Resolve organization names or 9-digit organisasjonsnummer against the Norwegian Brreg registry. Useful when verifying who actually maintains a package, owns a security disclosure inbox, or backs a vendor.

supportedInterfaces.description: MCP streamable-http endpoint. 11 tools: audit_dependencies (batch up to 20), audit_github_repo, audit_dependency_tree, lookup_npm_package, lookup_pypi_package, lookup_cargo_crate, lookup_go_module, lookup_github_repo, lookup_business, lookup_business_by_org, query_commitment. Anonymous 15/day, unlimited with bearer key.
REST audit endpoint. POST { packages: ["name", ...] }. Non-npm ecosystems via prefix: "pypi:litellm", "cargo:serde", "golang:github.com/gin-gonic/gin".

Zero-install CLI: `npx -y proof-of-commitment audit` auto-detects package.json, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, go.mod, go.sum. Flags: --file, --pypi, --cargo, --golang, --json, --sarif, --fail-on=critical. Aliases: audit, scan, check.
Drop-in GitHub Action gates PRs on CRITICAL or COMPROMISED packages. Posts a comment with the per-package scoreBreakdown.
Web-based audit UI. Paste names, drop a lock file, or scan a GitHub repo by URL. Free; no signup. Shareable result URLs.
Public rankings of CRITICAL packages by ecosystem and weekly download volume.
